facts.fact: Aphelion 停灵室：Kaspan 遗体（盐糖草药驱蝇、爱人睡过的金线毯将裹尸火化）；遗孀 Anatolia 有孕——两颗心搏同步又分开——「I’ve heard this song once」（她自己死过的心跳）。
复活之问：遗孀懇求——Risha 拒绝：「Necromancy cannot bring the dead back to life...to revive someone completely is…」——Impossible——若非她胸口那颗被荆棘刺穿过的心；「Can you put his soul at ease?」——「I'll do what I can.」
父训回响：GHOST 声部翻出父亲遗言——「Why should they be comforted when I cannot?」
facts.anchor: “This isn’t what I taught you.” Those were some of his last words.

facts.fact: 尸检与凶手：bisected feather 之伤深过 Rian 的——「this time, Taesia had known what to aim for, and had not hesitated」；natron 吸湿盐（干湖床所产——「Of which there are now more than ever」）。
facts.anchor: It was more precise than Rian’s injury had been

facts.fact: 共感的塌方：通灵重演凶案（如当年 Don Soler）——「Taesia had slaughtered this man who would have been a father...It was condemnable. It was unforgivable. But—」——怒火不再遥远。
facts.anchor: And suddenly Taesia’s fury was not so distant.

facts.fact: 附体危机：她滑入 Kaspan 死前记忆——gilded throne 上的 Phos 怪物——借她之口以 Solari 喊「He will use us. He will kill us all! Burn me! Burn me!」——Phos 泣眼睁大。
尸变：Kaspan 尸体挣坐断肋——bisected feather 亮起刺目白光——Phos 借尸宣告：「IT WAS FOOLISH TO COME HERE...I GAVE YOU THE OPTION TO DIE IN YOUR HOMES...HERE, THERE WILL BE NO ONE TO MOURN YOU.」
facts.anchor: IT WAS FOOLISH TO COME HERE,

facts.fact: 章末：光剑自尸手成形、房间晶灯闪烁——尸体以不该有的速度跃下桌子直扑三人。
